query:
UPDATE molecule_synergies 
SET type = 'neutralisation' 
WHERE description LIKE '%neutralise%' 
   OR description LIKE '%neutralisation%'
   OR chemical_mechanism LIKE '%antagonis%'
   OR chemical_mechanism LIKE '%neutrali%';
